description: This week, the House also passed the following resolutions. House Resolution 948 will establish a House Study Committee on Pharmacy Benefits Managers and Consumer Access to Prescription Medications. This committee is responsible for examining the rising drug costs and the impact of pharmacy benefit managers on those costs. House Resolution 1049 was passed to designate the last Wednesday in October each year as Fentanyl and Opioid Awareness Day in Georgia. This aims to raise awareness of opioid-related overdose deaths, which have more than doubled since 2019. House Resolution 145 is an “urging” resolution to encourage the Department of Education and the Department of Public Health to collaborate and prioritize the expansion of vision and hearing screenings at various grade levels to identify students with undiagnosed vision and hearing problems.
title: Legislative Week 9 Recap-Rep. Carmen Rice
